top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain that enabled incretin-based therapies with large clinical, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The three-laureate allocation and a physiology-scoped citation are defensible, though Knudsen's omission and Mojsov/Habener priority remain real attribution reservations. These do not justify withholding the prize.
